daily.title: Only 59% of urban Indians recognise milk as a complete protein, survey finds
daily.summary: A Godrej Jersey survey finds only 59% of urban Indians recognise milk as a complete protein, despite its affordability and widespread consumption. Only 59 per cent of urban Indian consumers recognise milk as a complete protein, a survey by dairy brand Godrej Jersey showed, meaning more than four in 10 are either wrong or unsure that it contains all nine essential amino acids the body needs. The study, called Lactograph 2.0 and conducted by YouGov across eight Indian cities, found a gap between how often people consume milk and how well they understand its nutritional value.
